description: This file defines data structures and enums related to linting messages and results, including classes for representing lint messages and results, severity levels, and methods for manipulating and converting these objects.

classes.name: LintSeverity
classes.description: Enumeration of severity levels for lint messages (error, warning, advice, disabled).

classes.name: LintMessage
classes.description: Data class representing a lint message with details such as code, name, severity, location, description, and replacement text.

classes.name: LintResult
classes.description: Data class representing a lint result, including methods for applying edits, checking containment, and converting to messages.

methods.name: asdict
methods.description: Converts a dataclass instance to a dictionary.

methods.name: is_edit
methods.description: Property that checks if the lint result is an edit operation.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the lint result edit to a list of lines.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if this lint result contains another lint result.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Calculates the end position of the lint result based on start position and length.

methods.name: as_message
methods.description: Converts the lint result into a lint message object.

methods.name: sort_key
methods.description: Provides a sorting key for lint results based on line, character, and name.
